result.description: Canonical conformance test guide. Three rules: rule-high (keywords: critical, sensitive → outcome HIGH), rule-low (keywords: public, open → outcome LOW), rule-ctrl-a (keywords: controlled, restricted → outcome HIGH/CTRL-A). Tests: scan finds keyword hits, evaluate aggregates outcomes, evaluateMany rolls up the outcomes of the rules selected from each guide.
result.name: Reference Guide 1
